shots.action_description: The roaster tips a scoop of freshly roasted beans into a cooling tray beside the small drum roaster and studies the color.
shots.visual_prompt: a middle-aged coffee roaster, a person with short salt-and-pepper hair, rolled-up chambray shirt and waxed canvas apron with a brass pin, standing beside a small drum coffee roaster, burlap coffee sacks on a pallet, chalkboard on the wall, early morning sidelight from one window
shots.voiceover_line: Every batch is roasted small, in the back room of our first shop.

shots.action_description: The roaster's hand, burn scar on the forearm, writes today's date on a kraft coffee bag label with a grease pencil.
shots.visual_prompt: close up of a person's hand holding a grease pencil over a blank kraft paper coffee bag label, small burn scar on the forearm, roasted coffee beans spilling from the open bag, wooden work table, warm practical bulb light
shots.voiceover_line: Every bag carries the day it was roasted.

shots.action_description: In the new shop, the roaster, in the same waxed canvas apron with the brass pin, hands a dated bag across the reclaimed oak counter to the regular in a cycling cap; 'Now Open' is lettered on the window behind them.
shots.visual_prompt: interior of a small coffee shop seen from inside, reclaimed oak counter, two-group espresso machine, a coffee roaster in a waxed canvas apron behind the counter handing a kraft paper coffee bag to a customer in a cycling cap and olive rain jacket, large front window onto the street, morning light
shots.voiceover_line: Same roaster, now a short walk closer. Stop in this week.
